original_answer: The paper embeds the AutoSlog-TS pattern learner in a bootstrapping framework to learn additional patterns from the large pool of unannotated debate forum posts in the IAC dataset [7]. The process works as follows: the labeled training data is first given to AutoSlog-TS, which generates patterns and associated statistics [5]. The resulting high-precision patterns are then used to identify more FACTUAL and FEELING texts from 11,561 unannotated posts from 4forums.com, where posts that match at least 3 patterns associated with a given class are assigned to that class [6]. A Bootstrapped Data Balancer then randomly selects a balanced subset of the newly classified posts to maintain the same proportion of FACTUAL vs. FEELING documents throughout the process, these new documents are added to the labeled set, and the bootstrapping process repeats using the same threshold values to select new high-precision patterns [8].

cited_sources.text: 2.2.2 Bootstrapping Procedure Since the IAC data set contains a large num- ber of unannotated debate forum posts, we embedd AutoSlog-TS in a bootstrapping framework to learn additional patterns. The ﬂow diagram for the boot- strapping system is shown in Figure 4. Figure 4: Flow Diagram for Bootstrapping Process Initially, we give the labeled training data to AutoSlog-TS, which generates patterns and asso- ciated statistics.

The high-precision patterns are then used in the bootstrapping framework to identify more FACTUAL and FEELING texts from the 11,561 unannotated posts, also from 4forums.com. For each round of bootstrapping, the current set of FACTUAL and FEELING patterns are matched against the unanno- tated texts, and posts that match at least 3 patterns associated with a given class are assigned to that class.

To accomplish this, we use the AutoSlog-TS sys- tem (Riloff, 1996) to extract linguistic expressions from the annotated texts. Since the IAC also con- tains a large collection of unannotated texts, we then embed AutoSlog-TS in a bootstrapping framework to learn additional linguistic expressions from the unannotated texts. First, we brieﬂy describe the AutoSlog-TS pattern learner and the set of pattern templates that we used.

As shown in Figure 4, the Bootstrapped Data Balancer then randomly selects a balanced subset of the newly classiﬁed posts to maintain the same proportion of FACTUAL vs. FEELING documents throughout the bootstrapping process. These new documents are added to the set of labeled docu- ments, and the bootstrapping process repeats. We use the same threshold values to select new high- precision patterns for all iterations.
